rule.evidence: Full source/target prompts only; no images, generated outputs, scores or GT masks used in token selection.
rule.preprocessing: Remove only literal [ and ] PIE annotation delimiters; preserve spelling, punctuation, case and whitespace. Raw prompts remain available.
rule.selection: Compare word spans, retain changed content words, and add the affected object noun when the change is an attribute, action, count, material, style or viewpoint. For object replacement the changed noun itself is sufficient. Exclude articles, conjunctions and prepositions from mask tokens.
rule.insert_delete: Use a common prompt object noun on both sides as context, including the otherwise empty side. Choose the affected object, support surface, or scene noun. Never invent a token absent from that side's prompt.
rule.manual_review: All 50 pairs reviewed individually in REVIEW. Context choice is semantic and explicit, not a POS-model or image-based inference. Each row documents its decision. manual_context_required flags insertion/deletion/count cases whose changed words alone give an empty or article-only side.
rule.conflicts: Prompt pair determines the edit when instruction disagrees; keep source spelling including rasing and brwon. Record conflicts without rewriting prompts.
rule.generation_inputs: Only the upstream case fields plus case and seed are required. No evaluation_only paths or GT masks are included.
rule.matching: Tokens are literal words/phrases from the corresponding cleaned prompt; actual model-tokenizer matching is performed by the runner, not executed here.
